answer: Make admission prove scarce live bandwidth. The network opens a timed transfer gauntlet: every identity must simultaneously push and pull real data against many random peers inside a tight delta of wall-clock time. One operator's uplink is a fixed pipe, so splitting it across a swarm of clones drops each clone's measured throughput to a whisper, while a genuine lone node saturates its channel like an open ocean. Fake fleets cannot forge aggregate capacity they do not physically own.
